purpose: Define the human-facing Live projection for explicit multi-party contention barriers without creating or overriding execution authority.
authority_boundary: This file defines projection only. Durable portfolio pin/claim/return evidence remains authoritative. Barrier entrant, RELEASE, collision and timeout receipts never promote Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w.
scope: Only fixtures explicitly opted into contention_barrier_mode under PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1. Ordinary portfolio jobs do not acquire barrier states.

WAITING_FOR_CONTENDERS.predicate: worker has a valid entrant receipt; no valid RELEASE exists; observed time is before deadline_at; no timeout receipt exists for that worker

RELEASED_TO_RACE.predicate: valid RELEASE exists with grants_execution_authority=false and worker is listed in entrant_worker_ids; worker has not yet won/lost the deterministic pin race

WINNER.predicate: worker owns the highest valid deterministic pin generation for the fixture job and any execution claim matches that pin

COLLISION_LOSER.predicate: worker has a valid prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 receipt for the attempted generation with next_action=REENTER_ALLOCATION and no matching winning claim

TIMEOUT.predicate: deadline reached without RELEASE and worker has a timeout receipt with pin_attempted=false and next_action=REENTER_ALLOCATION

precedence: A terminal portfolio RETURN is terminal for the job and overrides historical barrier display states.
A valid highest-generation pin determines execution owner; Live must never infer an owner from entrant or RELEASE receipts.
A collision receipt identifies a loser only for its attempted generation and cannot invalidate the durable winner.
A timeout state is valid only when no RELEASE existed before deadline and pin_attempted=false.
WAITING_FOR_CONTENDERS and RELEASED_TO_RACE are timing projections, not worker assignment authority.

liveness_overlay.winner_only: After a pin winner exists, apply normal worker/job liveness: ACTIVE <6m, STALE_SUSPECT 6-10m, REPLACEABLE >=10m when retry-safe and nonterminal.
liveness_overlay.pre_pin: Before a pin exists, barrier timing states must not be presented as an authoritative WORKING owner.

non_promotion: This binding projection contract does not make production /w operational and does not imply Human Acceptance or Served state.
